product.name: Browserbase Headless Browser Infrastructure
product.description: A cloud platform to run, manage, and monitor headless browsers at scale for AI agents and applications.

product.name: Stagehand Framework
product.description: An open-source browser automation framework for building web agents and automations.

product.name: Director
product.description: A no-code web automation tool that generates Stagehand scripts through AI-driven chat interaction.

product.name: Live View Feature
product.description: An embeddable iframe to observe and control browser sessions in real time within applications.

product.name: Proxy and Stealth Management
product.description: Managed CAPTCHA solving, residential proxies, and browser fingerprint configuration to support uninterrupted automation.
